fields.description: Genuine append-only history, server clock at ingest time (not the agent-reported timestamp) — matches Host Health's own convention. The "current" reading for a host is just its latest row by collected_at (see the (monitored_host, collected_at) index).
fields.label: Collected At

fields.description: os.cpu_count() at collection time, stored per-row (not looked up elsewhere) so history stays self-consistent if a guest is later resized. Used only to normalize load average — never conflated with Proxmox Guest/Server's own hypervisor-observed CPU usage percent.
fields.label: CPU Core Count

fields.description: (load_avg_1min / cpu_core_count) * 100 — compared against Resource Monitor Settings' Load Warning/Critical thresholds.
fields.label: Load (% of cores)

fields.description: Consecutive polls load has stayed at/above the Warning threshold, no dip. Computed at ingest time from the prior row for this monitored_host, since there's no persistent doc to mutate in-memory on an append-only table — same approach Frappe Worker Health Log's orphan_critical_streak uses.
fields.label: Load Warning Streak

fields.description: Same semantics as Load Warning Streak, at the Critical threshold. Reaching Confirmation Checks raises the High Load Average alert.
fields.label: Load Critical Streak

fields.description: Null (not 0) when this row's swap_total_gb is also null (no swap configured) — same null-not-zero convention as Proxmox Server.swap_usage.
fields.label: Swap Used (GB)

fields.description: Null when the host has no swap configured at all — 0 would misleadingly read as "swap is fine" rather than "there's no swap to measure".
fields.label: Swap Total (GB)

fields.description: Same confirmation-check semantics as Load Warning Streak, tracked independently for swap (different scale — load can exceed 100%, swap can't — so the two are never combined via max()).
fields.label: Swap Warning Streak

fields.description: Same semantics as Swap Warning Streak, at the Critical threshold. Reaching Confirmation Checks raises the High Swap Usage alert.
fields.label: Swap Critical Streak
